status: Feasibility and metadata marginals only; no sign-motif contingency counts, feature selection, tests or semantic claims.
type_code_interpretation: No authoritative type-code dictionary located in the bounded local inspection. SEAL:S overwhelmingly co-occurs with raw shape square; SEAL:R rectangular/cuboid; SEAL:C circular; SEAL:CY cylindrical. These are metadata observations, not a certified stamp-seal ontology. Exact code scopes remain separate; no final stamp-type eligibility chosen.

parser.order: source_file_order; no reversal or reading-order authentication
parser.sign_count_check: Only when raw signs.isdigit(); compare token length to int(signs)
parser.quality_filter: None; condition and preservation are unfiltered marginals
parser.iconography_difference: Existing audit strips all selected fields then permits NR when raw text length is 5; no new exception used in standard strict counts.
parser.missing_motif_policy: Exclude from labelled analyses; literal None is absent metadata, not certified absence of an animal. No splitting compound labels or animal-name normalization.

artifact_rule: strip(cisi) unless in ABSENT; otherwise 'lipi_id:' + id.split('.')[0]. This is a provisional export grouping, not verified physical artifact/die independence.
prepare_corpora_artifact_rule_difference: prepare_corpora.main treats only ['', '-', '--', '?'] as absent CISI; existing iconography additionally treats None and Unknown absent.
identity_limitations: CISI labels and lipi integer roots are not primary-authenticated physical-object identifiers in this audit.
Rows with a common artifact key may represent different faces, lines or source transcription entries; decimal row suffix alone does not authenticate a face.
Different texts on one artifact are not automatically contradictory readings; do not flatten or copy a motif across them.
Identical texts across distinct artifact keys are not automatically duplicate objects and are not collapsed here.
Counts of declared sides versus exported rows are descriptive discrepancies, not proof of error; export may omit uninscribed faces.
Same motif label repeated across faces is not an independent observation. Same-artifact rows must not enter independent train/test units.
Unknown motifs stay excluded from labelled subsets. Multiple distinct known labels require explicit treatment; no tie-breaking has occurred.
reproduction_protocol: Evaluate parse_lipi(row); retain only empty reasons. Count exclusion reasons overlapping.
Compute only raw metadata value histograms and grouped whole-text equality/difference counts; never sign-specific motif joint counts.
Build artifact keys with the published ABSENT set and fallback rule. Group independently inside every named exact-code/site scope.
Known motif means symbol.strip() not in ABSENT; histogram labels themselves remain raw.
For comparison only call existing parse_record with its FIELDS values stripped.
Examples selected in sorted artifact-key order by five predefined identity-anomaly categories; at most one per category, avoiding repeats.
